comments.value: This affects other scale related parameters as well, such as EyeHeightAsMeters. This issue also occurs on not just late joiners, but freshly loaded avatars in general, as far as I can tell.
Confirmed this is still an issue on 1341
Is there any update for fixing the sync issue?

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name} I see the Spookality theme involves the use of scaled parameters

It would be nice if this bug was fixed before that

details:
Join a new instance with a non-1.0 scale, and existing players will see your avatar in a state as if your ScaleFactor was 1.0.

Adjusting your scale at any time resolves the issue for existing peers, and seems to immediately resync the parameter to the other players, but future late joiners will still see your avatar as if ScaleFactor was 1.0.
title: ScaleFactor is not synchronized to late joiners or existing players in newly joined instance
